# References no state sets keep their default values. A discovery without
# parameters (or whose parameters are all blank) finds any device of its kind,
# so it doesn't identify hardware and isn't a matcher.
VARIABLE usb_id 2341:*
VARIABLE unused_id ""
VARIABLE port ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/serial_discovery.py ${usb_id} 1A86:7523
VARIABLE any_port ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/serial_discovery.py
VARIABLE blank_port ""
  VARIABLE_DISCOVERY openc3/discovery/serial_discovery.py ${unused_id}
